profile.headline: Partner Software Engineer @ Xbox
profile.summary: Experienced Engineering Director in the game industry. Skilled in Xbox, C/C++. C#, DirectX, Microsoft XNA.

positions.title: Partner Software Engineer - Xbox
Engineering Director
Principal Development Engineering Manager - Engine and Tools Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Manage a group of 8 engineering managers who own Engine and Tools Core Tech areas of Halo Infinite with a team of over 65 engineers. 
--- Teams include Systems, Graphics, PC, Infrastructure, Tools & Workflows, Pipelines, and Audio.
- Shipped Halo Infinite

positions.title: Principal Lead Software Development Engineer - Systems Engineering Lead
positions.description: - Engineering lead for Systems team a group of 7 engineers who own File IO, memory management, packaging, threading, content build system, input, Visual Studio & XDK updates.

positions.title: Principal Lead Software Development Engineer - Xbox One Platform Dev Plat Lead
positions.description:
- Engineering lead for group of 8 owning developer facing XDK APIs for the Xbox console
--- Areas included: App Model, User Events, Input, Connected Storage, Packaging, Licensing, etc. 
- Launched the Xbox One S and Xbox One X
- Personally implemented changes to Minecraft to render at 4k on Xbox One X for the first time
- Led team to though Xbox OS update that required large amount of compatibility work to ensure existing games and applications continued to function
- Helped titles ship on Xbox One

C/C++, Xbox One XDK, DirectX

positions.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - Xbox One Platform Team
positions.description:
- Improved game deployment stack on Xbox One devkit by over 500% and even higher for many small files
- Greatly increased the reliability of file transfers to the Xbox One devkit
- Created novel approach to allow developer to have multiple games with different OS versions on their devkit at once
- Implemented changes to allow CoreCLR to run on Xbox One devkits while in developer mode

C/C++, Xbox One XDK, DirectX

positions.title: Principal Lead Software Development Engineer Test - Durango / Xbox One Launch Team
positions.description:
- One of the initial members of the Durango aka Xbox One Platform team.
- Built team to validate the new development platform and operating systems we built for Xbox One
- Team created samples and small game experiences to validate platform for real world games
- Personally upgraded multiple internal and external game engines to latest Durango XDKs checking in required changes to their teams branches

C/C++, Xbox One XDK, DirectX

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - Microsoft Game Studios
positions.description:
- Work on connected experience game titles across platforms including Windows Phone 7 
- Shipped Beards and Beaks for Windows Phone 7
- Owner for a number of feature areas including Xbox LIVE integration, leaderboards, 
achievements, sound effect cue management, and path finding system.
- Built server game framework and rendering tech on Azure using D3D Warp that would later be used in the game Galactic Reign

XNA, C#, C/C++, ASP .NET, WCF, Azure, SQL

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Development Engineer - XNA Development Platform
positions.description:
- Led XNA framework development team to complete XNA Game Studio 4 across three 
platforms Windows, Windows Phone 7, and Xbox 360.
- Prioritized development resources across multiple platform deliverables and schedules.
- Worked across numerous external teams to drive resolutions of issues.
- Helped to implement the XNA Game Studio 4 graphics stack on Windows Phone 7.
- Defined and implemented XNA Framework APIs including Avatars.
- Original member of the team that launched Xbox LIVE Indie Games and the supporting 
backend publishing system.
- Started on the team as an individual contributor and was promoted multiple times to 
become the lead software development engineer for the XNA framework.
- Co-author of the book "XNA Game Studio 4.0 Programming: Developing for Windows Phone 7 and Xbox 360" published by Addison Wesley.
- Presented the talk "Avatars and XNA Game Studio End to End" at Gamefest 2010

C/C++, C#, XNA Game Studio, DirectX, HLSL, Xbox 360 XDK, Windows Phone 7

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained web based applications. Software utilized server side 
technologies to create Membership, Content Management, E-Commerce, Banking, 
Student Records, and Human Resource applications.
ASP, ASP .NET, VB Script, HTML, CSS, Java Script
